probes.name: the slug allowlist is what rejects a separator, a space and an empty segment
the dot-segment check is what rejects `..`
the length cap is 64, measured before the allowlist
the slug is validated per `/`-separated segment, so nesting is legal
nesting is flattened with `+`, which the slug allowlist excludes
the worktree branch prefix is `worktree-`
the tmux session name uses the repo BASENAME, not the whole path
the tmux session name joins repo and branch with `_`
the tmux session name sanitizes `.` as well as `/`
the `#N` PR form is anchored at both ends
the PR URL shape is /pull/N on any host
an unrecognized reference falls through to null, not to a number
the macOS tmux hint names Homebrew
probes.find:
case 'macos':
      return 'Install tmux with: brew install tmux'
probes.replace:
case 'macos':
      return 'Install tmux with: port install tmux'

probes.name: linux shares the tmux hint arm with wsl
the Windows tmux arm offers no install command
probes.find: return 'tmux is not natively available on Windows. Consider using WSL or Cygwin.'
probes.replace: return 'tmux is not natively available on Windows.'

probes.name: an unrecognized platform falls through to the generic tmux hint
probes.find: return 'Install tmux using your system package manager.'
probes.replace: return 'Install tmux with your package manager.'

probes.name: the mutation lock waits on the previous holder of the same key
the lock's release is what lets the next same-key holder run
a throwing critical section still runs the whole release/evict finally
the critical section's return value is what the lock resolves to
probes.replace:
await fn()
    return undefined as T

restoreWorktreeSession writes the live binding
